user.title: Set up FoxESS Globird Energy Observer
user.description: Compatible entities from one unambiguous FoxESS Modbus device and one Tessie vehicle are pre-filled when detected. Verify every suggestion and sign convention. Choose exactly one FoxESS owner: observer, local Modbus, or FoxCloud Mode Scheduler. HEO creates its own Charge to Full, automatic battery-charge, and house-occupancy controls after setup; do not create helpers for them. Local battery charging is a default-off extension; ZEROHERO export remains the ported inverter policy. The Safety Lock is ON by default.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FoxESS Globird Energy Observer
reconfigure.description: Detected entities fill missing mappings and replace only stale mappings that no longer exist; nothing changes until you submit this form. Verify every suggestion. Charge to Full and house occupancy are HEO-owned controls, not helper mappings. Update site limits and the exclusive FoxESS owner as required. Safety Lock ON blocks all hardware writes.

data.confirm_overnight: I explicitly intend this battery charging window to cross midnight

error.invalid_entity: Select a valid Home Assistant entity.
error.incomplete_foxess_mapping: Map all three FoxESS control entities, or leave all three unmapped.
error.incomplete_ev_mapping: Commissioned EV control requires every Tessie telemetry and actuator mapping.
error.solar_spill_battery_power_mapping_requir: Solar-spill charging requires an explicitly mapped signed battery-power sensor.
error.outside_ev_policy_requires_local_modbus: Solar-spill and pre-free EV charging require Local Modbus to be selected as the FoxESS control owner.
error.multiphase_current_mapping_required: Commissioned multiphase EV control requires a signed most-loaded phase grid-current sensor.
error.invalid_ev_location_mode: Choose Auto, Home, or Away EV location policy.
error.invalid_house_occupancy_mode: Choose Auto, Home, or Away house-energy occupancy policy.
error.invalid_ev_priority: Choose house-battery or EV free-window priority.
error.invalid_ev_charge_path: Choose direct EVSE or smart socket.
error.incomplete_smart_socket_mapping: Commissioned smart-socket control requires its switch mapping and a current limit at least as high as the commissioned EV minimum.
error.invalid_site_limits: Check capacity, floor, reserve, charger, inverter, current, and voltage limits.
error.invalid_daily_ev_backfill: Daily EV backfill requires a commissioned inverter output/discharge limit, a non-zero outside-window percentage, and a ready time before the free-power window.
error.invalid_schedule: Choose different free-charge times and a non-negative fallback.
error.invalid_foxess_control_owner: Choose observer only, local Modbus, or FoxCloud Mode Scheduler.
error.invalid_power_direction: Choose the direction represented by a positive sensor value.
error.incomplete_split_battery_mapping: Map both battery charge and discharge magnitude sensors, or leave both blank.
error.schedule_confirmation_required: Confirm the exact 24-hour schedule before saving.
error.overnight_confirmation_required: An overnight charging window requires the separate crossing-midnight confirmation.

abort.schedule_confirmation_expired: The pending schedule confirmation expired. Reopen configuration and review the times again.
